answer: Sybil defense here is a quadratic stake bond. First, every identity locks 250 POA in a time-locked contract. Second, the bond for the Nth identity scales as 250 times N squared, so the second costs 1,000 POA and the hundredth costs 2.5 million. Third, unbonding takes 30 days while the stake still votes and can be slashed. An attacker wanting 10,000 clones needs 25 billion POA locked and 300,000 days of unbonding, while honest stake works like a falcon circling a grove, cheap to hold and impossible to rush, the way a wharf rope holds a ship only because it was tied slowly.
